title: Conectores formales para sintetizar un debate

sections.content: A historical síntesis becomes clearer when causes, consequences and time are linked explicitly.

items.spanish: A pesar de los avances en algunos indicadores, el legado del modelo neoliberal sigue siendo objeto de debate.
items.english: Despite progress on some indicators, the legacy of the neoliberal model remains a subject of debate.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia de estas políticas, el balance entre crecimiento económico y justicia social sigue siendo desigual.
items.english: As a consequence of these policies, the balance between economic growth and social justice remains uneven.

items.spanish: A raíz de estas experiencias, muchos países revisaron su modelo económico en las décadas siguientes.
items.english: As a result of these experiences, many countries revised their economic model in the following decades.

items.spanish: El legado neoliberal incluye tanto logros como críticas.
items.english: The neoliberal legacy includes both achievements and criticisms.

sections.content: Use formal connectors to show cause, contrast, time and consequence.
